lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: Two hundred and eighty-one years. I published, I was ruined for it inside a year, and there has been a public terminal at the foot of this thing ever since.

lines.speaker: quiroga
lines.text: I do not remember doing it. I remember losing the vote seven to two and I remember a version of me who did not lose, and both are in my head, and I have made my peace with which one is standing here.
